fasth3-8step-v2-drowzeys-tensorfold-sing: The studio's keys-tensorfold-studio:2.9.1 is a cross-platform payload carrier, explicitly not a runtime (README, GHCR prebuilt carrier). spark/build-engine.sh copies /payload/spark-engine from it onto the host. glm-5-3-flash-exl3-dflash2-vllm-dual: The kit's start scripts run ghcr.io/miaai-lab/glm-5.3-flash-2x-dgx-sparks:exl3-instanttensor (built 2026-09-16), which predates the kit's pinned commit by about a month of patches (mamba-align chunking, APC retention, tool_choice none, cache reset, load clone, dense FP8, DFlash2 EXL3, adaptive K, ...).
